title: British Shepherd's Pie Vegetarian
description: A classic British dish made vegetarian by replacing the traditional lamb with a rich vegetable filling. This comforting casserole is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: In a large pan, sauté the onions, mushrooms, and carrots over medium heat until the vegetables are tender.
Add the peas, nourishing broth, and British bitter beer to the pan. Bring to a simmer and cook until the liquid has reduced slightly.
In a separate pan, boil the chopped potatoes until they are tender.
Mash the cooked potatoes with a fork or potato masher.
Transfer the vegetable mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Spread the mashed potatoes over the top of the vegetable mixture.
Top with the shepherds pie mix and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
